name: Discriminatory Auction
summary: A sealed-bid multiunit auction where each winner pays exactly what they bid.
rules_text: There are K identical items for sale to N bidders. Each bidder has a private valuation for each unit and submits sealed bids, one price per unit they want. All bids are collected simultaneously. The K highest bids across all bidders win an item each. Each winner pays the amount of their own winning bid for that unit, not a uniform clearing price. Losing bids pay nothing. A bidder's payoff is sum of valuations of units won minus sum of prices paid. If bids tie for the last unit, tie-break randomly or by rule. No communication between bidders is allowed during bidding.
rating_reason: Auction game with bidding hidden values.
